title: Deferred: clipboard-preserving Copy fallback
refs: SPEC §§2,9 native-only v1 scope; P10 deferred future clipboard safety reference
goal: Deferred outside v1, not implemented or completed. Preserve the following future safety requirements; native UIA-only capture and explicit snippet/Markdown/tray Copy remain required.
